headline: 41 seconds of air. One truck.

scenes.say: Time stops while you hold your breath. A truck slides toward 5 people.
You have 41 seconds of air. The truck is 9 feet away.
You push it with everything you have. It doesn't move an inch.
Then you see the wheels. Locked wheels can't steer, NHTSA warns.

visual.head: THAT'S REAL
visual.text: hard braking without ABS can lock the wheels

scenes.say: So you climb into the cab and lift the driver's boots off the brake.
20 seconds left. You turn the wheel toward the snowbank.

visual.text: a quarter turn toward the snowbank

scenes.say: But the back corner still points at the old man inside. Full video on the channel.

beats.text: cliffhanger: hörnet siktar fortfarande på Hal

seo.summary:
Full video: https://youtu.be/<id>

Time only stays stopped while you hold your breath, and a box truck is sliding on black ice toward a bus shelter. You can't push it. But its wheels are locked, and NHTSA says that without antilock brakes, hard braking can lock the wheels and take away steering. A fictional What If story with a real fact.

Never practice holding your breath in water or alone.

forbattring.andring: DISTRIBUTIONSORDER 2: första TLI-Shorten – titel med sökförslag nr 1 + #shorts, EN vändning (låsta hjul), länk till långa videon först i beskrivningen, cliffhanger.

forbattring.vi_slår_den_med: Ett fysiskt problem som syns i varje bild (lastbilen, klockan AIR i hörnet räknar ned) och en verklig fakta som löser det, men slutet bara i långa videon.
